description: Assistant-polished candidate v1.1, not seeded or deployed. Reviewed-user approval required before production import.
target: Agency-scoped starter templates; initial pilot recommended only in Chris's home organization; expand later upon explicit approval.
notes: Preserve any existing personal or agency templates.
Seed is not a license to send messages. Enforce SMS consent / purpose, opt-outs, DNC, and applicable marketing email requirements in existing dispatch paths.
Template chooser replaces merge fields with current contact / agent / appointment values. Unset fields must be handled safely before send, not silently omitted in a way that creates broken messages.
Informational SMS classification is a starting draft; verify actual use and applicable consent rules before sending.
Do not auto-send; manual selection, preview and edit before user clicks Send.
Appointment templates should only be offered when a real appointment and its date/time are available.
Policy welcome should only be used after actual insurer issuance/in-force confirmation.
No unsupported promises of carrier approval, coverage start, or guaranteed prices.
This revised candidate adds Reply STOP to opt out to all marketing-purpose SMS bodies because the manual dispatch does not append it automatically.
The appointment confirmation/reminder drafts avoid appointment_date and appointment_time merge fields because current manual messaging does not populate them.
These messages are intended for manual composing only. Current workflow merge syntax differs; do not reuse in workflow actions without separate compatibility verification.
